name: Tailscale
purpose: Private network for admin access: databases, staging, and internal tools are never exposed to the public internet.

tasks.title: Tag the client build's devices
steps: Create a tag per client build, e.g. tag:<client-id>
Register servers with tagged, ephemeral, pre-authorized auth keys
tasks.doneWhen: Every machine for the build appears in the admin console under its tag.

tasks.title: Write least-privilege ACLs
steps: Default deny; grant only group:admins → tag:<client-id> on the ports actually needed
Keep the ACL file in GitHub and apply it through the Tailscale GitOps action
tasks.doneWhen: ACL tests in the policy file pass and changes go through pull requests.

tasks.title: Turn on Tailscale SSH and MagicDNS
steps: Replace public SSH with Tailscale SSH; close port 22 on the host firewall
Use MagicDNS names in runbooks instead of IPs
tasks.doneWhen: No admin port is reachable from the public internet.

tasks.title: Confirm staging is tailnet-only
steps: Check that staging and admin tools resolve only inside the tailnet (or behind Cloudflare Access, NN-CLOUDFLARE-04)
tasks.doneWhen: An off-tailnet request to staging fails.

tasks.title: Monthly device and key cleanup
steps: Remove stale devices and expired keys
Confirm key expiry is on for all human devices
tasks.doneWhen: No device older than 90 days without a check-in remains.
